variety_description: A high-yielding, medium-duration, semi-dwarf, short slender grain variety, grown extensively in central, west, and southern India. Developed by ICAR-IIRR and released in 2008. Highly adapted to irrigated lowlands. Good grain quality. Due to low glycemic index (51%) popularly known as ‘Tiffen Rice’ and targeted for type-2 diabetic patients. High HRR. Tolerant to major diseases and insect pests.
